card.name: Antidepressant suicidality warning wording
card.fires_on: Words inside the boxed antidepressant warning about suicidal thoughts, mainly 'children' and 'adults' in 'children, adolescents, and young adults'. Also fires on linking words like 'In' and 'including' in adverse-event listings.

modes.label: Age groups in suicidality warning
modes.description: The age-group words 'children' or 'adults' in the antidepressant suicidality warning sentence.

modes.label: Linking words in trial results
modes.description: Short linking words that start a study description or an included-term list in adverse-event text.

card.plain: It marks the age groups in the antidepressant suicidality warning and a few linking words in trial-result text.
